gaps.question: Is there a board-approved ICT risk framework mapped to DORA Articles 5–16?
Are critical or important functions (CIFs) formally identified and documented?
Has proportionality been assessed and documented for your entity class?
Can you classify a major ICT incident against the DORA criteria within the reporting clock?
Are NCA submission templates and deadlines tracked end-to-end?
Is there a tested escalation runbook from detection to initial notification?
Is there a risk-based digital operational resilience testing programme (not just annual pen tests)?
If in scope, is TLPT (threat-led penetration testing) scoped and scheduled?
Are test findings tracked to closure with board visibility?
Is the register of information for all ICT third-party arrangements complete and current?
Do critical ICT contracts contain the DORA-mandated provisions (audit, exit, sub-outsourcing)?
Is ICT concentration risk measured and reported (single-provider dependencies)?
